item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 06/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windier with a few showers over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Sunday night to Monday morning. The weather will be fine and dry over the region in the following few days. It will be cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Date/Month: 07/10 (Friday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Sunny intervals and a few showers.
Temp range: 26 - 31 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
